listing.name: Hillock Prototype and Station Tech
listing.summary: Provides refined collision models and shield resizing for this mod.
listing.aiSummary: Provides refined collision models and shield resizing for this mod.

description: Offers a patch containing updated .ship files for Hillock Prototype and Station Tech. These files refine point assignment for better accuracy and performance, resize and recenter oversized shields, and adjust collision radii.
